title: Making security audits more like the doctor’s office is a good thing
summary: Security certifications are table stakes for Blend. Of course, this is also true for other organizations in critical infrastructure spaces like financial services, healthcare, and government contracting. Proof of a comprehensive security compliance program is often necessary to sell your product or services, and the audits that precede certification can be costly in terms of fees, time, and lost opportunities to improve other components of your security program.
